name: 親子作業の階層グループ
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
Create ONE static Japanese Lighthouse expanded parent/child task group LH09-0028. Original images1–2 are primary: reproduce original silhouettes, enclosures, optical stroke, proportions, alignment, indentation, row spacing, grid and distinct visible states. Japanese mock3 supplies task wording only; do NOT copy its substitute diamond, omitted counters, invented dates or repeated assignees.
A very wide compact flat table fragment approximately1188x140 logical pixels. Three task rows each35px tall plus a35px add-subtask row. Seven columns, cumulative divider coordinates x522,636,750,863,976,1089,1188. Fine neutral rules. Ordinary rows and whole canvas pure white #FFFFFF, no gray/mint broad panels, no raised rounded cards, no table header/sidebar/toolbar.
Row1 parent: original filled DOWN disclosure triangle, thin outlined circle with checkmark, title「礼拝の資料を準備する」Regular14/24. Then exactly numeral1 + small blue thumbs-up, numeral2 + original tiny connected-node dependency glyph. Assignee cell2: white thin-border circle「山」and「山田 花子」Regular12/16. Cell3 original empty calendar enclosed in dashed circle. Other cells empty.
Row2 selected child: indent first-cell content to original x58 logical pixels. Original small APPROVAL glyph: rounded rectangular outlined badge containing a tiny person/head-and-shoulders shape; NOT a diamond, not a padlock. Title「資料の承認を依頼する」, then numeral1 and thin original comment bubble. Assignee cell2 uses ORIGINAL dark photo avatar appearance from source and Japanese label「佐藤 光」. Cell3 dashed-circle empty calendar. Cell6 Japanese truncated summary「内部確認…」; cells4,5,7 blank. Preserve selected state using official brand gradient135deg #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E across ONLY this single row, with white high-contrast text/icons on it. Keep original icon enclosures and silhouettes legible.
Row3 child: same indentation as row2. Thin outlined circular CHECKMARK, title「活動の目的を文書にする」. Cell2 original UNASSIGNED action: dashed circular outline surrounding small thin person icon, with NO assignee name/avatar. Cell3 dashed-circle empty calendar. Remaining cells blank.
Row4:「子作業を追加…」muted Regular14/24 aligned with child titles x81px. No grid inside this last add-subtask row, as original.
Do not show dates: all three original calendar cells are empty actions. Do not duplicate assignees. No extra counters, rows or invented summaries. Use Meiryo Regular14/24 task text, Regular12/16 metadata, zero tracking; never bold the whole fragment. Supporting icons #526173 outside selected row; semantic source blue like icon retained. Preserve photo artwork appearance; no watermark, labels, perspective, device shell, annotation or comparison board. Tight framing with minimal outer whitespace.
reviewNotes: 親子3行、承認バッジ・コメント1・親カウンター1/2・未割当と空期日を確認。選択行は正式緑グラデーションに適応。親のアバターが禁止のミント塗りのため白面へ訂正。列幅と原本画像・厳密フォントの同一性は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
